recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17103 unless the work group separately requests new examples beyond the existing active profiling examples page.
issue_request: FHIR-17103 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request for the STU3 profiling discriminator section asking for further discriminator examples, possibly on a new page, because the existing examples were too terse.
initial_application: Jira records that additional documentation was added in GH#5eb7bea34d. The matching commit 5eb7bea34d48bcd3e1eb73f891066c1e11f1ec8c added discriminator-type notes and typical examples to source/profiling.html, and that guidance remains present in the current source with later refinements.
additional_context: source/profiling-examples.html is an active Profiling FHIR child page in source/hierarchy.xml and contains detailed StructureDefinition and instance examples for Patient.telecom slicing, fixed-order slicing, blood pressure Observation.component slicing, extension slicing, and DiagnosticReport.result slicing. Later commits including FHIR-25738 and FHIR-23035 maintained or refined the same profiling documentation family without reversing the seed decision. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-17103 guidance.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current in-build profiling pages already provide the additional discriminator examples requested by the issue and the main profiling page links readers to the examples page.
